classification.difficultyReason: The student reads the 70° ray and adds or subtracts 360° repeatedly. They must also respect the bounded range, which means choosing n and excluding out-of-range values, so there are only two answers. This is a little more than a single coterminal conversion.

content.prompt: List all the angles of inclination between $-720^{\circ}$ and $0^{\circ}$ that this ray could represent.
